pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
Support and exploration doll. Does not attack but provides a guiding aura and coordinate search.

HP: 120. Regen IV + Resistance II.

pages.title: Guiding Aura
pages.text:
Radius: 32 blocks. Owner within range receives:
• Speed II + Jump Boost II + Armor +4

Only the owner benefits. Effects expire when leaving range.

pages.title: Coordinate Search
pages.text: Click "Search" in the Guide Doll inventory. Three tabs: Structures / Biomes / Villages. Results are sorted by distance. Click a target to search. Checkmark button marks visited — persists across restarts.

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text: Craft the Guide Doll Head, then the Guide Doll Egg. Name the egg on an anvil to summon.

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text: 8 paper surround the Guide Doll Head.
